data.name: Pebble Stack

heroImage.alt: A stack of carefully balanced stones beside a peaceful river, with a frog, a height meter and tools to rotate and adjust the pebbles

data.fullDescription: Pebble Stack — a physics game about balancing stones. Each level hands you a few pebbles of different shapes and a flat rock. Find the balance point and stack as high as you can. If it falls, you try again. It's calmer than it sounds.
